title: A quasi-compact morphism has quasi-compact inverse images of quasi-compact opens (Stacks 01K4)
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], i.e. $f^{-1}(V)$ is quasi-compact for every affine open $V\subseteq Y$. Let $W\subseteq Y$ be an open subset which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] in the topology induced from $Y$ (every covering of $W$ by opens of $W$ has a finite subcovering). Then $f^{-1}(W)\subseteq X$ is quasi-compact in the topology induced from $X$.
